## What to read, and what wins

**normative**

- `AGENTS.md`: conventions for agents and humans. source of truth for: conventions, crate map, build and test.
- `PLAN.md`: epic-level execution plan. source of truth for: scope, epics, acceptance invariants.
- `DECISIONS.md`: decision log D1–D80 (append-only); consult before choosing alternatives. source of truth for: architecture decisions.
- `docs/GLOSSARY.md`: vocabulary; use these terms.
- `docs/FLYWHEEL.md`: the process (flows and roles) in prose.
- `docs/BLOG_PLAN.md`: blog plan and seeding.

**descriptive**

- `docs/harness-architecture.md`: canonical runtime design.
- `docs/THESIS.md`: positioning (five layers).
- `README.md`: public overview, status, test counts.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes; Unreleased section is the next release (release).
- `blog/DEPLOY.md`: deploy runbook (Cloudflare, Namecheap, Search Console).

**ephemeral**

- `HANDOFF.md`: note from the last session (session).
- `_tasks`: one file per flywheel item (item).

## Work flows

### flywheel: A threat found in the wild becomes a defense, then a post, then feedback

Items: finding. Defined in `docs/FLYWHEEL.md`.
State lives in **_tasks/<phase>/<slug>.md** (truth), mirrored in Linear issue status (manual), GitHub issue state (manual).
Manual mirrors are your job: a transition is not done until every mirror shows it.

| From | To | Who | Gate | Effects |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| discovery | development | maintainer | — | triage; mv the file |
| development | advocacy | engine | rust-checks | append a technical summary to the item; mv the file |
| advocacy | done | critic | blog-checks, correcting-review | append a Review note; mv the file |
| advocacy | development | critic | — | re-queue only when the fix needs the owner's rework |

### change: A tracked issue becomes merged code

Items: issue. Defined in `AGENTS.md (conventions), branch and commit naming`.
State lives in **Linear issue status** (truth), mirrored in GitHub issue state (manual), GitHub PR state (auto), PLAN.md epic checkboxes (manual).
Manual mirrors are your job: a transition is not done until every mirror shows it.

| From | To | Who | Gate | Effects |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| open | in-progress | engine | — | branch <agent>/<key>-<slug> |
| in-progress | in-review | engine | rust-checks, readme-sync, wasm-refresh, governance-bench, demos-check, decision-record | PR titled [AI2-<n> / #<n>] …, marked ready for review |
| in-review | in-progress | maintainer | — | review comments |
| in-review | merged | maintainer | rust-checks | — |
| merged | closed | engine | trackers-sync | close in GitHub and Linear; tick PLAN checkbox |

### release: Unreleased changes become a published version on npm and GitHub Releases

Items: release. Defined in `.github/workflows/release.yml, CHANGELOG.md, D70`.
State lives in **CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased → version)** (truth), mirrored in git tag v* (manual), published npm version (auto).
Manual mirrors are your job: a transition is not done until every mirror shows it.

| From | To | Who | Gate | Effects |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| unreleased | bump-pr | engine | release-rehearsal | bump versions; date the changelog section |
| bump-pr | tagged | maintainer | — | merge; push tag v<version> |
| tagged | published | ci-pipeline | — | build binaries; publish npm; create GitHub Release |

### post: A blog post goes from draft to deployed and seeded

Items: post. Defined in `docs/BLOG_PLAN.md, blog/DEPLOY.md, blog/social/README.md`.
State lives in **blog/src/content/blog/<slug>.md, field draft** (truth).

| From | To | Who | Gate | Effects |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| draft | illustrated | illustrator | — | hero in house style |
| illustrated | reviewed | critic | correcting-review, blog-checks | — |
| reviewed | published | maintainer | — | merge to the production branch; Cloudflare deploys |
| published | seeded | maintainer | — | post HN / Reddit / X from blog/social/<slug>.md |

## Roles

- **maintainer** (human): Triage, approvals, merges, tags, dashboards, social seeding
  - inbox: flywheel.discovery, change.in-review, release.bump-pr, post.reviewed
- **radar** (codex → claude-code): Find new threats and write one discovery file per finding
  - writes only: `_tasks/1_discovery/**`, `scripts/**`
- **engine** (claude-code → codex → grok-bot): Write the failing test, implement the defense, keep the suite green
  - inbox: flywheel.development, change.open, release.unreleased
  - writes only: `crates/**`, `tests/**`, `_tasks/2_development/**`
- **megaphone** (claude-code → codex → antigravity): Turn a shipped defense into a demo (.tape) and a post
  - inbox: flywheel.advocacy, post.draft
  - writes only: `docs/**`, `blog/**`, `_tasks/3_advocacy/**`
- **illustrator** (antigravity): Generate hero images in the house style (see _tasks/3_advocacy/hero-illustrations.md)
  - writes only: `blog/src/assets/**`
  - requires: image-generation
- **critic** (codex → claude-code): Correcting review of a handed-off artifact; fixes in place, serialized, never concurrent with the owner
  - inbox: flywheel.advocacy, post.illustrated
  - writes only: `crates/**`, `docs/**`, `blog/**`
- **ci-pipeline** (automation): GitHub Actions; the only path to npm and GitHub Releases

## Procedures and rules

- **rust-checks** (recipe): Build, test, format and lint the workspace on the pinned toolchain. _enforced by CI `ci.yml`._
  - `cargo build --workspace --offline`
  - `cargo test --workspace --offline`
  - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
  - `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings`
- **wasm-refresh** (obligation): Rebuild the committed WASM engine and copy it into blog/public/vendor/harness-wasm/. When you touch `crates/harness-preview/**`, `crates/compiler/**`. Defined in AGENTS.md, D60. _enforced by CI `ci.yml / wasm`._
  - `(cd crates/harness-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --release)`
  - `cp crates/harness-wasm/pkg/harness_wasm{_bg.wasm,.js} blog/public/vendor/harness-wasm/`
  - `node scripts/check-wasm-freshness.mjs`
- **governance-bench** (obligation): Regenerate the governance benchmark results (committed build output). When: kernel, gate ABI, projection or approval store changed. Defined in AGENTS.md, D76. _enforced by CI `ci.yml / governance-bench`._
  - `bash scripts/run-governance-bench.sh`
- **demos-check** (obligation): Run every demo and assert the verdict lines it claims to show. When: kernel changed. _enforced by CI `ci.yml / demos`._
  - `bash scripts/check-demos.sh`
- **release-rehearsal** (recipe): Rehearse the npm publish path short of publishing. Defined in AGENTS.md, D70. _enforced by CI `ci.yml / release-dry-run`._
  - `cargo build --release --locked -p cli-harness`
  - `bash scripts/assemble-npm-packages.sh`
  - `node npm/verify-packages.js && node scripts/check-npm-pack.mjs`
- **blog-checks** (recipe): Build the site and check drafts, heroes and spacing. _enforced by CI `ci.yml`._
  - `cd blog && npm run build && npm run check:drafts && npm run check:heroes && npm run check:spacing`
- **correcting-review** (recipe): Audit a handed-off artifact and fix defects in place (technical accuracy, SEO), then note what changed. Defined in docs/FLYWHEEL.md §3, .claude/agents/correcting-reviewer.md (the role), .claude/commands/review-blog.md (the steps). Claude Code: `/review-blog`.
- **readme-sync** (obligation): Update README status, layout, build and test counts, and PLAN checkboxes in the same commit. When: every commit that changes status. Defined in AGENTS.md. _**not enforced: nothing fails if you skip it**._
- **trackers-sync** (obligation): Reflect every task state change in both GitHub and Linear; done on one side is not done. Defined in AGENTS.md. _**not enforced: nothing fails if you skip it**._
- **decision-record** (obligation): Append a D<n> entry (decision, alternatives, why) when a choice closes off a real alternative. Defined in AGENTS.md. _**not enforced: nothing fails if you skip it**._
- **no-reference-repos** (prohibition): Never git add repos/ (reference checkouts); stage paths explicitly. Defined in AGENTS.md. _**not enforced: nothing fails if you skip it**._
- **no-hook-moves** (prohibition): Never move or delete .claude/hooks/world-gate.py mid-session; a missing hook bricks every tool call. Defined in AGENTS.md, D37. _**not enforced: nothing fails if you skip it**._

## Continuity: so the next agent can pick up

- Cite items as `[{linear} / {github}]` in PR titles and commit subjects.
- Key `linear`: `AI2-\d+`. Linear issue; often a parent spanning several PRs (AI2-25 → #92–#95).
- Key `github`: `#\d+`. GitHub issue (a PR number is resolved to key pr).
- Branch name: `{agent}/{slug}`.
- e.g. PR title: [AI2-25 / #87] Add deterministic doctor fixtures and read-only behavior proof
- e.g. branches: cursor/doctor-fixtures-87-15e5 (Grok Bot), claude/jira-demo-narrative-uo0wij, codex/ai2-10-authorization-instance, blog/harness-blocked-itself
- Session record: HANDOFF.md on the working branch. Update it after every meaningful step, not only at the end of a session. Readable by local agents.
- Item record: the item's _tasks file (appended summary). Update it on each flywheel transition. Readable by local and cloud agents.
- Item record: PR description and comments. Update it when the PR is opened, and on each push (Grok Bot). Readable by local and cloud agents.

You can be stopped at any moment (usage limit, crash). Keep the records above current as you go;
a record written only at the end is never written when it matters.
